تسلوا (form I)
# تَسُلُّوا (tasullū) /ta.sul.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of سَلَّ (salla)
# تُسَلُّوا (tusallū) /tu.sal.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of سَلَّ (salla) and سُلَّ (sulla)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
